name: rexcast
title: Rexcast
description: See and control your Rex terminal sessions from Raycast: activity in the menu bar, peek at any session and send text to it.
author: carlos_arze

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: Rex CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the rex binary installed with the Rex app.

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Manage Sessions
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: List, show, rename and close Rex sessions, and inspect their tabs and panes.

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Session
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Create a Rex session and show it in the app.

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Run Command
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Run a command in a new tab of a Rex session.

commands.name: open-rex
commands.title: Open Rex
commands.description: Bring the Rex app to the front.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Session Activity
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Show which Rex sessions are active or finished, without opening Rex.

preferences.name: notifications
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Show Notifications
preferences.description: Show a message when a session needs your input, finishes or fails. Off by default because the message closes the Raycast window if it is open. The menu bar item updates either way.

preferences.name: noticeDuration
preferences.title: Notification Length
preferences.description: How long the message stays up. A longer message keeps closing the Raycast window while it is shown.

commands.name: show-menu-bar
commands.title: Show Menu Bar Item
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Show the Rex activity item in the menu bar again after removing it.

commands.name: peek
commands.title: Peek at Session
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Look at the screen of a Rex session without opening Rex.

commands.name: open-folder
commands.title: Open Finder Folder in Rex
commands.description: Create a Rex session in the folder selected in Finder.

commands.name: send-text
commands.title: Send Text to Session
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Type text or the clipboard into a Rex session without focusing Rex.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
